title: A Two-stage Transformer Framework for Temporal Localization of Distracted Driver Behaviors

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: Early works such as Space-Time Attention [10] and Transformer-in-Transformer (TNT) [11] demonstrated that self-attention can effectively capture spatio-temporal relationships in video sequences.

problems.name: Boundary Ambiguity and Localization Precision
problems.evidence_sentence: Although recent transformer-based and self-supervised advancements provide a promising foundation, further refinement is required to achieve robust temporal boundary precision.

problems.name: Dataset, Benchmark, and Evaluation Mismatch
problems.evidence_sentence: Real-world driver-monitoring data further complicate this problem due to inconsistent video quality, sparse annotations, and frequent occlusions caused by steering-wheel motion or changes in driver appearance.

methods.name: Coarse-to-Fine or Hierarchical Localization
methods.evidence_sentence: Our approach follows a two-stage pipeline that combines VideoMAE-based feature extraction with an Augmented Self-Mask Attention (AMA) detector, enhanced by a Spatial Pyramid Pooling-Fast (SPPF) module to capture multi-scale temporal features.

methods.name: Transformer/DETR-Style Proposal Decoding
methods.evidence_sentence: Early works such as Space-Time Attention [10] and Transformer-in-Transformer (TNT) [11] demonstrated that self-attention can effectively capture spatio-temporal relationships in video sequences.

methods.name: Object/Event/Spatio-Temporal Modules
methods.evidence_sentence: Early works such as Space-Time Attention [10] and Transformer-in-Transformer (TNT) [11] demonstrated that self-attention can effectively capture spatio-temporal relationships in video sequences.

methods.name: Pretraining, Pseudo-Labeling, and Data Generation
methods.evidence_sentence: VideoMAE [14] introduced a simple yet highly effective masked modeling strategy for self-supervised pretraining on large video corpora, enabling models to learn robust spatio-temporal features even under limited supervision.
